class.name: InputMapSettingsEvent
class.brief_description: One event as stored in the file of [InputMapSettingsServer].
class.description: The file form of one bindable [InputEvent] (key, mouse button, gamepad button or gamepad axis) in the settings file of [InputMapSettingsServer]: named fields instead of a sub-resource, the same in JSON, INI, YAML, TOML and XML. [InputMapSettingsServer] converts between [InputEvent] and this record when it saves and loads; games do not need this class, but [method to_text] and [method from_text] give the text form of an event.

method.name: from_event
method.description: Returns the record of [param event], or [code]null[/code] for event types that have none (touch, MIDI, ...). A key with a physical keycode is written with [constant KEY_MODE_PHYSICAL], other keys with [constant KEY_MODE_LABEL]. The [member device_id] is the number of the pad for a gamepad event of one pad, otherwise [code]Any[/code].

method.name: from_text
method.description: Returns the record of a text form such as [code]Keyboard:Ctrl+S[/code], [code]KeyboardLabel:E[/code], [code]Mouse:Left[/code], [code]Gamepad:A@Any[/code] or [code]GamepadAxis:LeftX-@1[/code], or [code]null[/code] if the text is not valid. The names of version 2 files ([code]Key:[/code], [code]PhysicalKey:[/code], [code]KeyLabel:[/code], [code]MouseButton:[/code], [code]JoypadButton:[/code], [code]JoypadMotion:[/code]) are read, too.

method.name: to_event
method.description: Returns a new event of this record, or [code]null[/code] if it is not valid (no [member input], an unknown name, a [member direction] that is not [code]+[/code] or [code]-[/code]). The event reacts to all devices ([member InputEvent.device] [code]-1[/code]), a gamepad event with a number in [member device_id] only to that pad.

method.name: to_text
method.description: Returns the text form of this record: [code]Keyboard:Ctrl+S[/code], [code]KeyboardLabel:E[/code], [code]Mouse:Left[/code], [code]Gamepad:A@Any[/code] (a button always has [code]@Any[/code] or [code]@[/code] and the number of its pad) or [code]GamepadAxis:LeftX-[/code] ([code]@[/code] and the number only for one pad).

members.member: The kind of event: [constant DEVICE_KEYBOARD], [constant DEVICE_MOUSE] or [constant DEVICE_GAMEPAD]. Written as [code]Keyboard[/code], [code]Mouse[/code] or [code]Gamepad[/code].
The pad of a gamepad event: [code]Any[/code] (all pads) or the number of one pad.
The direction of a gamepad axis, [code]+[/code] or [code]-[/code]. Empty for all other events (a gamepad button has no direction).

The key, button or axis: a key name such as [code]W[/code], [code]Space[/code] or [code]Left[/code], a mouse button ([code]Left[/code], [code]WheelUp[/code], ...), a gamepad button ([code]A[/code], [code]LeftShoulder[/code], ...) or a gamepad axis ([code]LeftX[/code], [code]TriggerRight[/code], ...). The names are those of [method InputAction.text_to_event].

How a key is matched: [constant KEY_MODE_PHYSICAL] (the key position, [member InputEventKey.physical_keycode]) or [constant KEY_MODE_LABEL] (the key with this label on the current layout, [member InputEventKey.keycode]). Only for [constant DEVICE_KEYBOARD].

The modifiers, joined by [code]+[/code], for example [code]Ctrl+Shift[/code]. The names are [code]CmdOrCtrl[/code], [code]Ctrl[/code], [code]Alt[/code], [code]Shift[/code] and [code]Meta[/code]. Only for keyboard and mouse events.

constants.constant: The key at a position of the keyboard, whatever the layout.
The key with a label on the current layout.
